details:
The problem:

I want UserA and UserB's avatars to interact via contacts, but I want the result of the interaction to ONLY be visible on UserB's client.

The current workaround:

Both UserA and UserB are required to add a prefab to their avatars. UserA gets a pre-defined ContactReceiver. UserB gets a pre-defined local-only ContactSender.

Where the workaround fails:

Both Users require adding something to their avatar, making compatibility only function between those two avatars, it does not allow for more generic implementations.

An example of the workaround failing:

Below I have a concept of an avatar with a non-traditional mouth setup. Using the new SenderLocalPosition parameters, I am adjusting the position of the mouth in reference to the viewing player's Head contact. But the moment another user enters the radius, the setup is guaranteed to break.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n8JGTVGe2yI

A proposed solution:

Humanoid avatars generate generic ContactSenders, which can then be referenced under the `Body Parts` collision tag folder on contacts. These ContactSenders could be duplicated and set as `Local-Only`, adjusting the tag with a prefix. In ContactReceivers, an additional collision tag folder could be created called `Others Local Body Parts` to reference these remote local-only contacts.

This is similar to a few other feature request, but with the methodology somewhat flipped around and explained a bit more in-depth, with a proposed solution that I imagine would work within the limitations of contacts.

https://feedback.vrchat.com/avatar-30/p/add-new-local-behavior-for-contacts-local-to-touched

https://feedback.vrchat.com/avatar-30/p/local-non-network-synced-remote-contacts
title: Local-only `Body Parts` contacts for 'client-side' interactions on remote avatars
